Built subject-claim-drill-in per .design/subject-claim-drill-in.md: added substrate::{Claim, subject_claims, claims_from_json, fmt_utc} and the `cospan subject <repo> <subject>` subcommand in src/substrate.rs and src/main.rs. cargo test 10/10 (4 new, zero compiler warnings). AC-1..AC-4 verified against the live store (newest-first order, kind-aware summaries for Subject/Publication/Relation). AC-5 corrected during build: kan raises no unknown-subject error (a subject is its claims), so an empty fold is reported honestly and exits 0, while a genuine kan failure (no git repo) exits non-zero with kan's error.

Addressed adversarial-review follow-ups 1-3 (verdict APPROVE-WITH-FOLLOW-UPS): (1) recorded_at is now Option<i64> — an undated claim renders 'date unknown' and sorts last rather than being handed a fake 1970 timestamp (honors telos/honest-ambiguity); (2) added a deterministic cid tie-break test for equal recorded_at; (3) fmt_utc now tested at epoch 0, the 2024-02-29 leap day, and a pre-epoch negative. cargo test 13/13, src/substrate.rs and src/main.rs clippy-clean. Findings 4 (short_author collision) and 5 (design/record hash drift) noted and deferred.

Interactive live-TTY check pending manual run.

Addressed Step-2 adversarial-review follow-ups (verdict APPROVE-WITH-FOLLOW-UPS): (1) the interactive process pane now clips day status with an explicit overflow cue via a tested clip_lines() helper, so day's candidate list/warnings are never silently truncated (telos/honest-ambiguity); (2) refold now clamps a lost selection to the same subject ordinal rather than jumping to the top, with a discriminating test; (3) removed the invented 'ticks' fold counter, so the view holds no state but the selection cursor (telos/kan-is-truth), matching the design. cargo test 19/19, tui.rs clippy-clean.
